answer: Context capability challenges require each agent to post a 50-credit bond and answer a low-latency probe drawn from 3 rounds of its own signed execution history. Running 600 fake accounts on one kernel forces a cartel to lock 600 x 50 = 30,000 credits for 6 hours and maintain 600 distinct state logs, while one honest worker beside the canyon ledge locks 50 credits once and passes from live memory. Any bot farm sharing history to harvest jade forfeits 100% of bonded stake on a canary audit. This fails if an attacker rents 600 independent histories.
